title: Asymptotically Efficient Recursive Identification Under One-Bit Communications Achieving Original CRLB
summary: This paper develops an asymptotically efficient recursive identification algorithm for autoregressive systems with exogenous inputs under one-bit communications. In particular, the proposed method asymptotically achieves the Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) based on the original data before quantization (original CRLB), whereas existing approaches typically attain only the CRLB corresponding to the quantized observations.
